scope_limits: ablate_crossmodal removes prefix geometry constraints; it does not test independently generated cross-modal semantics.
ablate_covariance removes the explicit penalty, not all covariance-related state features. At selected lambda=0 that penalty is inactive.
The four Cells are decoder residual roles, not four independently generated modalities.
Missing/shuffled imagery harms grounding, but this alone does not establish superiority of NDU control.

audit_role: independent evidence checks within the collaborating development team, not an external third-party audit

best_of_two.claim: Same 10-second cap; actual measured costs differ. The second candidate reuses this episode encoder result only, and both decoder/verifier executions remain charged.

calibration_audit.scope: Held-out test comparison of unchanged raw versus probability-only calibrated verifier. Pooled source-cluster descriptive intervals account for repeated methods per source. No confidence guarantee, no test refit, no per-method calibration claim.

conclusion.experiment_flag_note: The frozen scorer intentionally defaults experiment_pass to false; scientific interpretation below is based on measured outcomes, not that default flag.
scientific_findings: The primary 64-source NDU point is dominated by several core baselines under measured quality, CVaR, wall cost and coverage.

Against mean_only, all primary quality deficit comes from the two encoder timeout sources; the remaining 62 matched completed sources have identical quality. This is exploratory attribution, not replacement of primary results.
The selected lambda is zero, so explicit risk/covariance penalties are inactive. Risk-trained weights remain, but benefit of the explicit penalty cannot be assessed here.

The experiment demonstrates a functioning bounded grounding/control/evaluation harness and real decoder interventions. It does not establish Merton optimality, continuous FBSDE solving, NDU-specific semantic or frontier superiority, or independent multimodal output generation.

attempted_vs_emitted_trace_exceptions.reason: Controller can execute before the post-forward budget check; a step rejected by that check has no emitted control entry. Cost and trajectory retain attempted work.

controls.claim_limits: Recorded local argmax changes combine Cell corrections and structural constraints; they prove decoder intervention, not independent semantic contribution or better final outcomes.

semantics: Episode wall time is exclusive per-worker online duration; process CPU time sums CPU use across worker threads and can exceed wall time.
The phase has two concurrent workers with four torch threads each. Summed episode wall time is not batch latency, and process CPU time is not the wall cap.
Resident base-model load durations are reported separately. Full initialization, scheduler/IPC work, parent scoring and persistence are in phase elapsed, outside each episode ledger.
The backbone calls field counts candidate generation invocations; zero-token timeout invocations can have zero decoder forward calls, which are separately audited.
A 10-second cap is a soft stop checked around decoder steps; a non-preemptible encoder/decoder call can overrun. Measured overrun costs and zero score are preserved.
The in-process communication ledger is zero; this is not a distributed communication benchmark.

exploratory_common_completed_sources.warning: Post-outcome conditioning on valid completion; diagnostic only, cannot replace primary 64-source results or identify causal semantic effects. No output was rerun or removed from the primary report.

methods: Complete score_episode rescore against independent references and actual PNG bytes; exact comparison with cached scores and frozen report scores.
Independent CVaR implementation uses rank-overlap weights; for 64 sources at alpha .9 the upper tail is six whole observations plus 0.4 of the seventh.
Independent NumPy source-paired bootstrap reproduces frozen intervals, then supplies labelled supplemental comparisons.
Cost-ledger reconciliation, per-candidate computation metadata, emitted controls and recorded trajectories are audited; no synthetic timings.
Recorded 24-feature policy states and deterministic per-checkpoint seeds are replayed through the frozen policy checkpoint; base generator is not rerun.
Raw and calibrated frozen verifier probabilities are recomputed on the same held-out test outputs; calibration parameter and feature/label digests are verified.

scope.bootstrap_interpretation: Descriptive paired source-cluster percentile intervals; 2000 draws, seed 20261022, no multiplicity adjustment and no confirmatory significance claim.

interpretation: Both NDU timeout episodes exhausted their wall cap in encoding before any decoder forward or control decision. Their primary zero scores are real budget failures, but cannot be attributed to BSDE or semantic control actions.
Observed encoder time varies substantially between methods on identical source images. The evidence localizes delays to encoding; it does not identify the host-level cause of resource variability.
The single shuffled-pair max_tokens event is a separate generation-length failure, not a wall-budget overrun.
Runtime exceptions=0 does not mean every episode completed within budget.
